review_policy: Quarterly and upon material standards, errata, cryptanalysis, protocol, supplier, validation-status, or architecture changes. This cadence is hub-defined.
scope_note: Official NIST publications; derived worksheet controls and annual phases are organization-defined recommendations, not NIST mandates. Future unpublished 2027+ guidance cannot be pre-certified.
